put.description: Sets monthly energy and operations cost (USD) for months of one year, in the app's own store; answers the whole year. The app's only write: it never reaches MDK or a device

200.description: The whole year's costs, after the update.

400.description: `ERR_BAD_COSTS`: `year` is missing or outside the years Cost Input covers, `months` is empty, a month is outside 1 to 12 or appears twice, or a cost is not a non-negative number or null.
